about: Grammar-budget probes against the OpenAI Responses API, 2026-10-16 (ADR-005). Each probe sent one grammar as a forced custom tool to gpt-6-luna with reasoning effort none and max_output_tokens 16 (text2sql.llm.LLMClient.grammar_accepted, flex tier). Rejections are HTTP 400 'Invalid lark grammar. regex construction fuel exhausted' and are not billed. Synthetic column names: 'attribute_NNNN_x' padded to 16 chars for feature series (flat alternation), random lowercase letters (seed 7) of the given width for template series.

series.name: c
series.description: first template (precedence tower, complex string regex)
series.template:
// SQLite SELECT grammar for database x (mode=benchmark, max_rows=1000).
start: query | abstain
query: with_clause? compound order_by? limit?
subquery: compound order_by? limit?
with_clause: "WITH " cte (", " cte)* " "
cte: CTE_NAME " AS " "(" subquery ")"
compound: select (SET_OP select)*
select: "SELECT " DISTINCT? select_list from_clause? where_clause? group_by? having?
select_list: select_item (", " select_item)*
select_item: expr (" AS " COLUMN)? | "*" | QUALIFIER "*"
from_clause: " FROM " source join*
source: (SOURCE | "(" subquery ")") (" AS " TABLE_ALIAS)?
join: JOIN_OP source (" ON " expr)? | ", " source
where_clause: " WHERE " expr
group_by: " GROUP BY " expr_list
having: " HAVING " expr
order_by: " ORDER BY " order_item (", " order_item)*
order_item: expr DIRECTION? NULLS_ORDER?
limit: " LIMIT " LIMIT_N (" OFFSET " OFFSET_N)?
expr_list: expr (", " expr)*
?expr: conjunction | expr " OR " conjunction
?conjunction: negation | conjunction " AND " negation
?negation: predicate | "NOT " negation
?predicate: sum
    | sum COMPARE sum
    | sum IS_NULL
    | sum IN_OP "(" (subquery | expr_list) ")"
    | sum LIKE_OP sum
    | sum BETWEEN_OP sum " AND " sum
?sum: product | sum ADD product
?product: concat | product MUL concat
?concat: unary | concat " || " unary
?unary: primary | "-" unary
?primary: column | NUMBER | STRING | CONSTANT | call | cast | case
    | "(" expr ")" | "(" subquery ")" | "EXISTS(" subquery ")"
column: QUALIFIER? COLUMN
call: "COUNT(" ("*" | DISTINCT? expr) ")"
    | AGGREGATE DISTINCT? expr_list ")"
    | FUNCTION expr_list ")"
cast: "CAST(" expr " AS " CAST_TYPE ")"
case: "CASE " (expr " WHEN " | "WHEN ") expr " THEN " expr (" WHEN " expr " THEN " expr)* (" ELSE " expr)? " END"
abstain: "ABSTAIN: " REASON
REASON: /[^\x00-\x1f\x7f]{1,300}/

SET_OP: / (?:UNION ALL|UNION|INTERSECT|EXCEPT) /
JOIN_OP: / (?:INNER |LEFT OUTER |LEFT |CROSS )?JOIN /
DIRECTION: / (?:ASC|DESC)/
COMPARE: / (?:<>|<=|>=|!=|=|<|>) /
IS_NULL: / IS (?:NOT )?NULL/
NULLS_ORDER: / NULLS (?:FIRST|LAST)/

FUNCTION: /(?:JULIANDAY|COALESCE|STRFTIME|REPLACE|LENGTH|NULLIF|SUBSTR|INSTR|LOWER|ROUND|UPPER|DATE|TRIM|ABS|IIF)\(/
TABLE_ALIAS: /T[1-9]/
CTE_NAME: /cte[1-5]/
QUALIFIER: /(?:T[1-9]|cte[1-5])\./
SOURCE: /(?:items|cte[1-5])/
COLUMN: /{cols}/
NUMBER: /[0-9]{1,18}(?:\.[0-9]{0,18})?(?:[eE][+-]?[0-9]{1,3})?/
STRING: /'(?:[^'\\;\/\-\x00-\x1f\x7f]|''|(?:-?\/){1,4}(?:[^'\\;\/*\-\x00-\x1f\x7f]|'')|(?:-?\/){0,4}-(?:[^'\\;\/\-\x00-\x1f\x7f]|'')){0,255}(?:(?:-?\/){1,4}|(?:-?\/){0,4}-)?'/

anylex: " " | " AND " | " AS " | " ELSE " | " END" | " FROM " | " GROUP BY " | " HAVING " | " LIMIT " | " OFFSET " | " ON " | " OR " | " ORDER BY " | " THEN " | " WHEN " | " WHERE " | " || " | "(" | ")" | "*" | ", " | "-" | "CASE " | "CAST(" | "COUNT(" | "EXISTS(" | "NOT " | "SELECT " | "WHEN " | "WITH " | DISTINCT | SET_OP | JOIN_OP | DIRECTION | COMPARE | IS_NULL | NULLS_ORDER | CONSTANT | IN_OP | LIKE_OP | BETWEEN_OP | ADD | MUL | CAST_TYPE | AGGREGATE | FUNCTION | TABLE_ALIAS | CTE_NAME | QUALIFIER | NUMBER | STRING | LIMIT_N | OFFSET_N
DISTINCT: "DISTINCT "
SET_OP: / (?:UNION ALL|UNION|INTERSECT|EXCEPT) /
JOIN_OP: / (?:INNER |LEFT OUTER |LEFT |CROSS )?JOIN /
DIRECTION: / (?:ASC|DESC)/
COMPARE: / (?:<>|<=|>=|!=|=|<|>) /
IS_NULL: / IS (?:NOT )?NULL/
NULLS_ORDER: / NULLS (?:FIRST|LAST)/
CONSTANT: /(?:CURRENT_TIMESTAMP|CURRENT_DATE|CURRENT_TIME|FALSE|NULL|TRUE)/
IN_OP: / (?:NOT )?IN /
LIKE_OP: / (?:NOT )?LIKE /
BETWEEN_OP: / (?:NOT )?BETWEEN /
ADD: / [-+] /
MUL: / [*\/%] /
CAST_TYPE: /(?:INTEGER|NUMERIC|REAL|TEXT)/
AGGREGATE: /(?:SUM|AVG|MIN|MAX)\(/
FUNCTION: /(?:JULIANDAY|COALESCE|STRFTIME|REPLACE|LENGTH|NULLIF|SUBSTR|INSTR|LOWER|ROUND|UPPER|DATE|TRIM|ABS|IIF)\(/
TABLE_ALIAS: /T[1-9]/
CTE_NAME: /cte[1-5]/
QUALIFIER: /(?:T[1-9]|cte[1-5])\./
NUMBER: /[0-9]{1,18}(?:\.[0-9]{0,18})?(?:[eE][+-]?[0-9]{1,3})?/
STRING: /'(?:[^'\\;\x00-\x1f\x7f]|''){0,255}'/
LIMIT_N: /(?:1000|[1-9][0-9]{2}|[1-9][0-9]{1}|[1-9])/
OFFSET_N: /[0-9]{1,6}/
SOURCE: /(?:items|cte[1-5])/
COLUMN: /{cols}/

series.name: j
series.description: minimal + 30 space-led keyword literals in one rule
series.template:
start: "SELECT " column (", " column)* " FROM " SOURCE (" WHERE " COLUMN kw COLUMN)?
kw: " K00WORD " | " K01WORD " | " K02WORD " | " K03WORD " | " K04WORD " | " K05WORD " | " K06WORD " | " K07WORD " | " K08WORD " | " K09WORD " | " K10WORD " | " K11WORD " | " K12WORD " | " K13WORD " | " K14WORD " | " K15WORD " | " K16WORD " | " K17WORD " | " K18WORD " | " K19WORD " | " K20WORD " | " K21WORD " | " K22WORD " | " K23WORD " | " K24WORD " | " K25WORD " | " K26WORD " | " K27WORD " | " K28WORD " | " K29WORD "
column: COLUMN
SOURCE: /(?:items|cte[1-5])/
COLUMN: /{cols}/

series.template:
